package br.com.caelum.cj05;

public class Login implements Action {

  private HttpServletRequest request;
  private String nome;

  public Login(HttpServletRequest request) {
    request = request;
  }

  public void execute() {
    this.request.getSession().setAttribute("usuario", this.nome);
  }

  public void setNome(String nome) {
    this.nome = nome;
  }

}
